newsitem.title: USA: Fujisawa claim against Kapoor reinstated.
newsitem.headline: Fujisawa claim against Kapoor reinstated.

text.p: Fujisawa USA Inc, a unit of Osaka, Japan-based Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, said Wednesday the U.S. Court of Appeals in Chicago reinstated a racketeering claim against John Kapoor, former chairman of Lyphomed Inc.

But the appeals court also affirmed the portions of a U.S. district court decision that found Fujisawa's securities law claims against Kapoor to be barred because they were not filed in a timely manner, Fujisawa said.
The case has been remanded to the federal district court in Chicago for trial.

The decision by the three-judge appellate panel reverses a July 1996 ruling by the lower court that found Fujisawa had not sufficiently alleged that Kapoor had engaged in a pattern of racketeering activity during the six-year period before Fujisawa's purchase of Lyphomed, a company then controlled by Kapoor, Fujisawa said.

The Seventh Circuit decision enables Fujisawa to pursue both racketeering and related common law claims against Kapoor, which is facing claims seeking damages of more than $250 million, the company said.
